title: Terms & Conditions
summary: The agreement between you and NOORÉ when you use this website or place an order.
body:
# Terms & Conditions

_Last updated: 1 October 2026_

Welcome to NOORÉ. By browsing this website or placing an order you agree to the terms below. Please read them — they are short, and written for people rather than lawyers.

## 1. Who we are

NOORÉ Fragrances ("NOORÉ", "we", "us") makes and sells hand-poured fragrance candles and gift sets from our studio in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. You can reach us at hello@noore.in.

## 2. Products

- Every candle is poured by hand, so small variations in colour, surface texture and label placement are normal and part of the charm.
- Product names, fragrance descriptions and imagery are indicative. Burn times are estimates based on correct candle care.
- We reserve the right to retire or reformulate a fragrance at any time.

## 3. Orders & pricing

- All prices are in Indian Rupees (₹) and include applicable taxes unless stated otherwise.
- An order is confirmed only once you receive our confirmation email. We may decline or cancel an order in case of pricing errors, stock issues or suspected fraud, and will refund any amount paid.
- Promotional codes cannot be combined unless stated, and have no cash value.

## 4. Shipping

We dispatch within 2 working days and deliver across India in 3–6 days. Risk in the goods passes to you on delivery. Please see our **Shipping & Returns** page for full details.

## 5. Returns & cancellations

Unlit, unused candles in their original packaging may be returned within 14 days of delivery. Personalised and corporate orders are final. See **Refund Policy** for how refunds are processed.

## 6. Candle safety

Candles are an open flame. Never leave a burning candle unattended, keep away from children, pets, drafts and flammable materials, and burn on a heat-resistant surface. We are not liable for damage arising from use that does not follow the care instructions supplied with each candle.

## 7. Intellectual property

The NOORÉ name, flame mark, product names, photography and website design are our property. Please ask before reusing them.

## 8. Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of India. Disputes are subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Jaipur, Rajasthan.

## 9. Changes

We may update these terms from time to time. The version published on this page at the time of your order applies to that order.

title: Privacy Policy
summary: What we collect, why, and how we look after it.
body:
# Privacy Policy

_Last updated: 1 October 2026_

We collect as little as we need to make and deliver your candles, and we never sell your data.

## What we collect

- **Order details** — your name, delivery address, phone number and email, so we can deliver and keep you informed.
- **Account details** — if you create an account, your name, email and a securely hashed password.
- **Messages** — anything you send us through the contact or corporate gifting forms.
- **Newsletter** — your email address, only if you subscribe.
- **Technical data** — basic analytics such as pages visited and device type, used in aggregate to improve the website.

## Payment information

Card and UPI payments are processed by our payment partner. We never see or store your full card number.

## How we use it

- To fulfil, deliver and support your orders.
- To answer your messages.
- To send the newsletter you asked for (unsubscribe in one click, any time).
- To keep the website secure and improve it.

## Sharing

We share data only with partners who need it to serve you: our courier (name, address, phone), our payment partner and our email provider. All are bound by their own privacy obligations.

## Retention

Order records are kept for as long as required by Indian tax law. Newsletter and account data are kept until you ask us to delete them.

## Your rights

You can ask us to access, correct or delete your personal data at any time by emailing hello@noore.in. We respond within 30 days.

## Cookies

We use a small number of cookies and local storage entries to remember your bag, your sign-in and your preferences. No advertising cookies are set.

## Contact

Questions about privacy: hello@noore.in.

title: Shipping & Returns
summary: Dispatch times, delivery windows and how returns work.
body:
# Shipping & Returns

## Shipping across India

- **Complimentary shipping** on all orders over ₹1,999.
- Orders under ₹1,999 ship for a flat ₹99.
- We dispatch within **2 working days**; most orders arrive in **3–6 days**. Metro cities are usually faster.
- You will receive a tracking link by email and WhatsApp as soon as your parcel leaves the studio.

## Packaging

Every candle travels in a moulded, recyclable insert inside a rigid box. Gift orders arrive in our ribboned linen box with a hand-written card if you asked for one.

## International orders

We currently ship within India only. For international gifting, write to hello@noore.in and we will try to help.

## Returns

Changed your mind? Unlit candles in their original packaging can be returned within **14 days** of delivery. Email us with your order number and we will arrange a pickup. Once received and inspected, your refund is processed within 5–7 working days.

## Damaged in transit

If anything arrives broken, send a photo to hello@noore.in within 48 hours of delivery. We will dispatch a replacement immediately — there is no need to send the damaged item back.

## Exceptions

Personalised, engraved and corporate orders are made to order and cannot be returned unless faulty.

title: Refund Policy
summary: How and when refunds are issued.
body:
# Refund Policy

## When you are eligible

- You return an unlit candle within 14 days of delivery.
- Your order arrived damaged and a replacement is not possible.
- We cancelled your order for any reason.

## How refunds are paid

Refunds go back to the original payment method:

- **Cards & UPI** — 5–7 working days after we approve the refund, depending on your bank.
- **Cash on delivery** — by bank transfer within 7 working days; we will ask for your account details.

## Partial refunds

If part of a gift set is returned, we refund the proportional value of that item. Gift wrap and shipping fees are refunded only when the whole order is returned due to our error.

## Questions

Write to hello@noore.in with your order number and we will sort it out.

title: Candle Care
summary: How to get the longest, cleanest burn from every NOORÉ candle.
body:
# Candle Care

A candle is a small ritual. A few habits make every burn longer, cleaner and safer.

## The first burn

Let the melted wax reach the edge of the vessel on the first light — usually **2–3 hours**. Wax has memory; a full first pool prevents tunnelling for the rest of the candle's life.

## Trim the wick

Before every burn, trim the wick to about **5 mm**. A long wick makes a tall, smoky flame and shortens burn time. For wooden wicks in the Luxury collection, pinch off the charred tip.

## Burn times

Burn for no more than 4 hours at a time. Stop using the candle when about 1 cm of wax remains, to protect the vessel and the surface beneath it.

## Keep it still

Drafts, fans and open windows cause flickering, soot and uneven pools. Choose a calm spot on a heat-resistant surface.

## Safety

- Never leave a burning candle unattended.
- Keep out of reach of children and pets.
- Keep away from curtains, books and anything flammable.
- Extinguish with a snuffer rather than blowing, to avoid smoke and wax splatter.

## After the last flame

Freeze the vessel for an hour, pop out the remaining wax disc, wash with warm soapy water — and keep it. Our vessels are made to live on as planters, catch-alls and brush holders.
